subject: authorization schema
required_rule: schema version and review id exact

subject: authorization claims
required_rule: exact 18 required claims

subject: authorization kind
required_rule: exact read-only evidence authorization kind

subject: owner approval
required_rule: owner identity and immutable owner decision id required

subject: authorization time
required_rule: not-before issued and expiry times ordered and validity no more than 86400 seconds

subject: anti replay
required_rule: token id nonce transaction id and receipt digest unique

subject: revocation epoch
required_rule: token epoch equals current owner authority epoch

subject: contract acceptance
required_rule: exact accepted contract id

subject: design acceptance
required_rule: exact accepted evidence design id

subject: repository head
required_rule: exact token-bound local repository head

subject: repository tree
required_rule: exact token-bound local repository tree

subject: remote head
required_rule: origin main equals token and local head

subject: executor uid
required_rule: numeric process uid exactly equals token uid

subject: coordinate receipt digest
required_rule: token binds exact canonical coordinate receipt sha256

subject: effect scope
required_rule: only read-only provider validation and transaction-scoped evidence outputs

subject: prohibited effects
required_rule: all runtime and acquisition effects explicitly denied

subject: coordinate schema
required_rule: schema version and review id exact

subject: coordinate envelope
required_rule: all 11 future envelope fields required

subject: coordinate rows
required_rule: exactly 41 rows

subject: coordinate row shape
required_rule: exact 10 fields per row

subject: contract row ids
required_rule: exact accepted 41 contract row id set

subject: object identity
required_rule: provider object digest size and soname match accepted contract

subject: path absolute
required_rule: path begins slash and is canonical UTF8

subject: path traversal
required_rule: no dot or dotdot component

subject: path expression
required_rule: no glob variable tilde command or search expression

subject: path uniqueness
required_rule: path text digest and canonical path unique across rows

subject: coordinate authority
required_rule: each row names exact immutable coordinate authority id and origin

subject: no discovery
required_rule: missing coordinates cause whole receipt rejection with no basename environment or filesystem inference

subject: receipt digest
required_rule: receipt digest computed over canonical document with digest field omitted

subject: candidate current state
required_rule: candidate contains zero live token zero receipt and zero coordinate rows
